familyTopicMap.rationale: Tenant/admin-center governance of estate access and settings.
Fabric Apps authoring, publishing, authentication and monitoring lifecycle.
Git integration and deployment pipelines are the lifecycle & operations topic.
Spark, notebook and Delta transformation work.
Pipelines, copy jobs and orchestration move data into the estate.
Notebook/Spark experimentation; analytical cross-placement attached as a secondary (S-DATA-SCIENCE-ANALYSIS).
Warehouse content centres on T-SQL analytical querying.
SQL database content is T-SQL relational querying; the fabric 'model' topic means semantic models & DAX, which this surface does not cover (documented deviation from the seed map example).
All embed-family articles embed Real-Time Dashboard items.
Capacity, billing, licensing and capacity planning are estate operations.
Documents the platform extension architecture (workloads, items, auth).
Platform fundamentals and architecture introductions.
Governance is half of the security & governance topic.
GQL graph querying and its language reference.
Fabric IQ ontologies and planning cubes/formulas model meaning over platform data.
Cross-topic issue index; the overview topic holds cross-topic material.
Mirroring replicates external databases into OneLake.
OneLake is the storage architecture.
The real-time hub feeds Real-Time Intelligence.
Eventhouse, KQL, eventstreams and activator are the streaming workload.
Direct match with the security & governance topic.
Workload development documents the platform architecture for extension authors.

refinementRules.description: Family default for enterprise/fundamentals AND compiled front-matter title matches /semantic model/i → fabric.model. Premium/Direct Lake semantic-model feature docs belong with the semantic-model topic rather than estate operations or platform fundamentals.
ms.subservice === 'pbi-transform-model' AND family default is not model → fabric.model. The transform-and-model subservice marks Power BI semantic-model feature docs.
